stories.title: Planning officer rejects defibrillator outside Mold building society over listed building setting
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has refused Nationwide permission for a defibrillator and bleed kit cabinet on the front of its Mold branch, ruling the defibrillator would harm the setting of the Grade II listed building next door. stories.title: Transport for Wales brings bus network proposals to Mold, Deeside, Flint and Holywell this month
stories.summary: People in Flintshire can question Transport for Wales about its proposed new bus network at four drop-in sessions this month, starting at Mold Library and Museum on Wednesday. stories.title: Wales has had its warmest summer on record, Met Office says
stories.summary: Wales has provisionally had its warmest summer since records began, with a mean temperature of 16.9°C, the Met Office has said. stories.title: Burst water main closes A494 for the day between New Brighton and Ewloe
stories.summary: The A494 will be closed eastbound between New Brighton and junction 33B at Ewloe throughout the day after a burst water main, Traffic Wales has said. stories.summary: Two boats reported drifting near Greenfield Dock on Monday afternoon turned out to be safely moored, Flint Coastguard Rescue Team said.
